notes_for_editor: No source found gives a build date, builder, use or condition. The Forest Lookouts page uses the name Hunters Mountain (Oxford), but no fetched source ties the tower to Hunters Mountain itself; mapping sites say Oxford Lookout Tower. TopoZone's Southbury map name is not a town (ExpertGPS files the tower under Oxford). Elevation differs slightly: 228 m (OpenStreetMap) against 233 m (TopoZone). Mindat and TrailsNH were blocked, so they are not cited. The firetower.org Connecticut register lists eight sites, none of them this one.
